description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Ice/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, En-Ice, En-Ice Stack, Cap Break Level 1, Dual Awoken Ice Mode I, 20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1 & Ice Ability Damage +5% to user
Dual Awoken Ice Mode I: Ice Ability Boost, Triplecast Ice & chases with single-target Ice/NE physical attack and 20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1 & Ice Ability Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to user when Damage Reduction Barrier is consumed (max 5 chases)
